instruction: I need to share some specific chapters with a colleague. Please extract the even-numbered chapters (2, 4, 6, 8) as individual PDFs, using the same naming convention as shown in chapter one.

metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary score: 1.0 if all expected PDF files are present with exact names, 0.0 otherwise.
